The '''Abo Dreth system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was a hotbed of rebel activity during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

[[Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla]] was dispatched to the Abo Dreth system with [[Naven Crel]] to investigate any possible links to the [[Abo Dreth]].
